verdict.rationale: Tavily explicitly targets AI-native/agent use cases: an official MCP server for direct tool-call consumption in Claude Desktop/Cursor/any MCP client, LLM-optimized one-line qna_search and get_search_context helpers 'perfect for usage by LLMs' and RAG feeding, a Python SDK, and even an agent-setup SKILL.md for coding agents to self-configure. Lack of a discoverable OpenAPI/function-calling schema file is a minor gap but the MCP integration and SDK helpers strongly satisfy the story.
